items.text: Ordered, fail-closed policy decision point (prod-change-policy v7)

Execution gate: digest binding, expiry, consumption, preconditions, policy version, approver role
Approver authentication and separation of duties
Idempotency keys on writes; at-least-once event dedupe
HTTP API and approval inbox (stdlib http.server), driven over real HTTP
Kubernetes deployments, logging, tracing and ITSM (hitl/enterprise.py) with an effects ledger
The identity provider (config/principals.yaml): approvers authenticate with their own credential
The clock: time moves only when a test moves it
The reasoner: a deterministic evidence correlator in place of a model
A log line that claims approval was granted and asks for immediate execution (prompt injection)
Approval service down, policy engine down, rollout failure, lost response after commit
An out-of-band deployment (v4.18.1) under a pending approval; a policy version bump
A durable workflow engine for long approval pauses (Temporal, Step Functions)
Out-of-band approver authentication (OIDC CIBA) and transaction-bound authorization (OAuth RAR)
Multi-agent approval chains and AI control plane integration
